nvidia_malaysia.description: NVIDIA Malaysia is a subsidiary of NVIDIA Corporation, a global leader in artificial intelligence and technology. NVIDIA Malaysia is responsible for the development and distribution of NVIDIA products and services in Malaysia. NVIDIA Malaysia is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
nvidia_malaysia.title: Cloud Architect
nvidia_malaysia.requirements: Overview: We are seeking an experienced SAP FI-CO Consultant with deep finance process expertise to deliver business value through SAP Finance technology solutions. As part of our Strategy & Consulting Global Network's (S&C GN) Centre of Excellence (CoE) based in the vibrant city of Kuala Lumpur, you’ll collaborate with top-tier local and international clients, as well as global Accenture teams. You’ll play a key role in shaping innovative solutions through system design, blueprinting, proof of concepts, and data modeling. This is more than just a consulting role — it’s a chance to be part of a global network, work on high-impact projects, and grow your career in a dynamic, multicultural environment. This role may involve occasional travel to client sites, both locally and internationally, depending on project needs. Key responsibilities of the role: Lead and deliver SAP S/4HANA Finance engagements across various implementation approaches. Advise clients on ERP product selection, value realization strategies, and conduct fit-gap assessments to align solutions with business needs. Facilitate workshops to gather business requirements and deliver key design decisions, business blueprints, and configuration documentation. Perform configuration for: General Ledger, Accounts Receivable/Payable, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Tax (Direct/Indirect), Real Estate (RE-FX), Financial Supply Chain Management (FSCM), Project System (PS) Design functional specifications based on user requirements and collaborate with technical teams for end-to-end integration. Prepare training materials and support end-user training to drive effective system adoption. Develop test plans, test strategies, test scopes, and define test cases. Execute testing activities including unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and user acceptance testing (UAT). Design and develop custom programs for data validation and extraction as part of the data migration strategy. Lead data migration efforts including: - Data validation, extraction, and conversion using LTMC, LSMW, ETL tools, or custom solutions. - Migration of master data (e.g., GL, cost/profit centers, assets, business partners) and transactional data. Manage project execution, client communications, and deliver within defined scope, timeline, and budget. Supervise analysts, consultants, and client personnel to drive successful project outcomes. Manage cutover activities and provide comprehensive post-go-live support to facilitate a smooth transition to the production environment.Job Qualifications: Total 4–7 years of relevant work experience, preferably with at least three of the following: - 1+ years working with SAP S/4HANA. - 2+ years working with SAP FI-CO. - 4+ years in finance technology-related projects. - At least one full-cycle SAP implementation experience. - Minimum 2 years of consulting experience in a Big Four or similar consulting firm. Experience as a Solution Architect or Design Authority in ERP advisory (e.g., product selection, fit-gap analysis, value realization). Proven ability to define business cases for S/4HANA transformation and perform ROI analysis. Strong client engagement skills, including business issue analysis, IT strategy definition, and stakeholder alignment. Experience in sales support, including lead generation, pipeline development, and proposal creation. Technical & Functional Skills: Deep knowledge of SAP Finance modules: FI, CO, PS, IM, VIM, DRC, OCR, MDG, AFC/FCC, ICMR, CFIN. Strong understanding of finance business processes: Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Treasury, Tax, Shared Services. Proficiency in SAP reporting tools: BI/BO, BW, SAC, and Fiori dashboards. Experience with SAP system integration across ECC and S/4HANA environments. Familiarity with digital finance technologies such as data science, blockchain, BlackLine, and big data is a plus. Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel (e.g., VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), and process documentation tools. Exposure to SAP Central Finance (CFIN) and intercompany processes. Experience in designing custom programs for data validation and extraction. Skilled in defining project scope, timelines, and deliverables for SAP S/4HANA implementations. Experienced in applying best practices for SAP project planning and execution. Proficient in translating business requirements into structured project plans and delivery frameworks Proactive in driving continuous improvement in methodologies, tools, and delivery practices. Experienced in applying best practices for SAP project planning and execution. About Accenture We work with one shared purpose: to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity. Every day, more than 775,000 of us help our stakeholders continuously reinvent. Together, we drive positive change and deliver value to our clients, partners, shareholders, communities, and each other.We believe that delivering value requires innovation, and innovation thrives in an inclusive and diverse environment. We actively foster a workplace free from bias, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is respected and empowered to do their best work.At Accenture, we see well-being holistically, supporting our people’s physical, mental, and financial health. We also provide opportunities to keep skills relevant through certifications, learning, and diverse work experiences. We’re proud to be consistently recognized as one of the World’s Best Workplaces™.Join Accenture to work at the heart of change. Visit us at www.accenture.com Equal Employment Opportunity Statement. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, military veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by applicable law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.
